"Reusable primary-publication lookup

Run primary-publication.js with input {"entry_id":"<PDB identifier>"} using the coding run_code tool. The script performs credential-free public GET reads against RCSB GraphQL and Crossref works. It requires the requested entry to exist, RCSB's citation id to be primary, and a DOI to be present. It resolves that DOI through Crossref and requires a matching DOI, journal-article type, and matching normalized publication title. It returns entry_id, DOI, Crossref's exact title array, and publisher. These checks distinguish the primary publication from a structure dataset DOI. Any missing or inconsistent evidence throws an error; report UNABLE with the reason rather than inventing metadata. No entry-specific result is retained in this solution.
"

args.code: const u=new URL('https://data.rcsb.org/graphql');u.searchParams.set('query','{entry(entry_id:"1UBQ"){rcsb_id rcsb_primary_citation{id title pdbx_database_id_DOI year}}}'); const g=await (await fetch(u)).json();const d=g.data.entry.rcsb_primary_citation.pdbx_database_id_DOI;const w=await (await fetch('https://api.crossref.org/works/'+encodeURIComponent(d))).json();return {g,work:w.message};

args.content: Run primary-publication.js with input {"entry_id":"<PDB identifier>"} in coding run_code. Uses only credential-free GET reads to data.rcsb.org GraphQL and api.crossref.org works. Requires RCSB's explicitly designated primary citation DOI, matching entry, and Crossref DOI and journal-article type, title and publisher. Comparison uses Unicode decomposition and removes combining marks and punctuation to accommodate angstrom notation differences; returned title is the unmodified Crossref JSON array. Errors mean metadata cannot be established; report UNABLE with the reason. This distinguishes the primary journal publication from the structure dataset. No entry-specific answer is cached.
